method: Exact scripted pixel plans drawn into three semantic layers through connected Pixloom MCP; no image generation or resampling.
brief: A long dark steel sword with a split shoulder, forked bronze crossguard and burgundy leather grip. Calm dark blade planes; a deliberate pale fuller.
sourceFormat: Version 1 numeric full-canvas indexed grids with explicit 100 ms still timeline; no animation requested.
migrationNote: The project spritex instructions point to an absent old executable/skill. Pixloom is the available successor, retaining numeric full-canvas authoring JSON and native integer-grid PNG/SVG exports. No spritex validation is claimed.
review: MCP actual enlarged image inspected for every project; all reviewed together at native and 2x on dark UI background. Runtime in-game review handled separately.
